exercises.question: Which sentence clearly gives a cause and consequence? [¿Cuál da claramente una causa y una consecuencia?]
options: Hubo un retraso porque faltaban unos documentos. [There was a delay because some documents were missing.]
Hubo un retraso ayer. [There was a delay yesterday.]
Habrá un retraso mañana. [There will be a delay tomorrow.]

exercises.sentence: Hubo un __ porque faltaban unos documentos. [There was a delay because some documents were missing.] (retraso)

exercises.english: Because of an error in the report, we had to repeat the analysis.

sentences: Primero apareció un problema. [First a problem appeared.]
Después identificamos la causa. [Then we identified the cause.]
Finalmente encontramos una solución. [Finally we found a solution.]

options: Hubo un retraso porque faltaba un documento. [There was a delay because a document was missing.]
Hubo una solución porque llegaremos tarde. [There was a solution because we will arrive late.]
Habrá un error porque ayer terminamos. [There will be an error because we finished yesterday.]

exercises.question: What does «por eso» introduce? [¿Qué introduce «por eso»?]
options: a consequence [una consecuencia]
a cause [una causa]
a condition [una condición]

exercises.sentence: El plazo era muy corto, por eso __ que trabajar más rápido. [The deadline was very short, so we had to work faster.] (tener)

exercises.english: The team found a solution, so we were able to finish the project.

exercises.sentence: Debido a un error en el informe, tuvimos que repetir el análisis.
options: Because of an error in the report, we had to repeat the analysis.
Because of a delay, we finished the report early.
Because of the solution, we rejected the report.

exercises.sentence: El plazo era muy corto, por eso tuvimos que trabajar más rápido.

options: Hubo un error en el informe, por eso tuvimos que repetir el análisis. [There was an error in the report, so we had to repeat the analysis.]
Hubo un error en el informe, por eso repetiremos el análisis ayer. [There was an error in the report, so we will repeat the analysis yesterday.]
Hubo una solución en el informe, por eso no tuvimos ningún problema. [There was a solution in the report, so we had no problem.]

exercises.question: Choose the correct cause connector. [Elige el conector correcto de causa.]
options: Debido a un error, tuvimos que repetir el trabajo. [Because of an error, we had to repeat the work.]
Por eso un error, tuvimos que repetir el trabajo. [Therefore an error, we had to repeat the work.]
Así que un error, tuvimos que repetir el trabajo. [So an error, we had to repeat the work.]

exercises.sentence: Encontramos una __, así que pudimos terminar el proyecto. [We found a solution, so we were able to finish the project.] (solución)

template.prompt: Explain a workplace problem and its cause.
template.answer: Hubo un retraso porque faltaban unos documentos.

template.prompt: Describe an error and a solution.
template.answer: Hubo un error en el informe, pero encontramos una solución rápidamente.

exercises.question: Which sentence correctly links cause and consequence? [¿Cuál conecta correctamente causa y consecuencia?]
options: El plazo era corto, así que trabajamos más rápido. [The deadline was short, so we worked faster.]
El plazo era corto, porque trabajamos más rápido. [The deadline was short because we worked faster.]
El plazo era corto, debido a trabajamos más rápido. [The deadline was short because we worked faster.]
